title: Italian Roasted Asparagus
blurb: Roasting the asparagus alone first keeps it from steaming under the cheese and tomatoes, which only go on for the last couple of minutes under the broiler.

ingredients.note: shredded, or Italian cheese blend, divided

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and lightly coat with nonstick spray.

Toss the asparagus with two-thirds of the oil; arrange in a single layer on the prepared pan. Season with salt and pepper. Roast 10 minutes, until crisp-tender. Remove from the oven and preheat the broiler.
Meanwhile, toss the cherry tomatoes with the remaining oil and half the cheese in an oven-safe bowl.

Transfer the asparagus to a baking dish. Top with the remaining cheese, then the tomato mixture. Broil 5 to 6 inches from the heat for 1 to 2 minutes, until the cheese is slightly melted. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and garnish with basil, if desired.
